text: A muscular male figure with a brownish skin tone stands center-frame. He has short black hair styled in two braids framing his face. His facial structure is angular, mouth open as if roaring. He wears a dark loincloth with green circular patterns and black arm bands. In one hand he grips a weapon; the other holds a staff-like object. His pose is aggressive, arms slightly outstretched. Behind him are jagged ice formations against a fiery red-orange sky.
